rows.name: Blazing Aura
rows.description: An inferno rages inside you, causing your body to radiate intense heat.

rows.name: Blistering Feint
rows.description: Your foes flinch from the heat of your weapon, giving you an opportunity to slip past their defenses.

rows.name: Blood Beak
rows.description: Your bleed attack is bloody and dangerous.

rows.name: Blundering Defense
rows.description: Your feverish and sometimes comical defensive techniques offer enough distraction to aid allies.

rows.name: Bullying Blow
rows.description: With a simple hit, you more easily intimidate an opponent.

rows.name: Cautious Fighter
rows.description: You care more about survival than victory.

rows.name: Claw Pounce
rows.description: You can charge and make an attack with your paws.

rows.name: Cleave Through
rows.description: You are ferocious at hewing smaller opponents.

rows.name: Cloven Helm
rows.description: Your helm turns aside lethal blows.

rows.name: Critical Versatility
rows.description: An open mind and combat training grant versatility to your critical hits.

rows.name: Demoralizing Lash
rows.description: You cow your enemies with the lash of a whip.

rows.name: Dented Helm
rows.description: Your helm protects you from hard hits.

rows.name: Desperate Swing
rows.description: You land your most telling blows in desperate situations.

rows.name: Destroyer's Blessing
rows.description: Breaking things adds to your power.

rows.name: Elven Battle Training
rows.description: You have been specially trained to wield a variety of traditional elven weapons.

rows.name: Ferocious Tenacity
rows.description: You spit in the face of death.

rows.name: Fire Hand
rows.description: Born with a torch in your hand, you have a gift with anything that burns.

rows.name: Giant Killer
rows.description: Your cleaving strokes menace giants and larger foes.

rows.name: Gloom Strike
rows.description: Few creatures are as accustomed to fighting in the shadows as you.

rows.name: Gnome Weapon Focus
rows.description: Your extensive training with traditional gnome weapons gives you an advantage.

rows.name: Goblin Cleaver
rows.description: You are ferocious at hewing smaller opponents.

rows.name: Goblin Gunslinger
rows.description: You have learned how to fire the big guns.

rows.name: Great Hatred
rows.description: Your rage burns with vast intensity.

rows.name: Grudge Fighter
rows.description: You feel great anger at anyone who dares to attack you, and this fury makes your own attacks that much stronger.

rows.name: Hard-Headed
rows.description: Your thick skull is almost a weapon unto itself.

rows.name: Improved Low Blow
rows.description: You are adept at hitting larger opponents where it hurts.

rows.name: Improved Surprise Follow-Through
rows.description: You follow up an attack with a surprising series of sweeping blows.

rows.name: Inner Flame
rows.description: Your body generates so much heat that your mere touch scorches your enemies.

rows.name: Kobold Ambusher
rows.description: You are adept at moving fast and staying hidden.

rows.name: Kobold Sniper
rows.description: You snipe quickly, making it harder for others to find the location of your attack.

rows.name: Lucky Strike
rows.description: Your luck increases the potency of your weapon attacks.

rows.name: Martial Mastery
rows.description: You broaden your study of weapons to encompass multiple similar weapons.

rows.name: Martial Versatility
rows.description: You further broaden your study of weapons to encompass multiple similar weapons.

rows.name: Nimble Striker
rows.description: You were born to charge your enemies and nobody does it better.

rows.name: Orc Hewer
rows.description: You are ferocious at hewing your enemies, especially orcs.

rows.name: Orc Weapon Expertise
rows.description: You can do more with the weapons orcs favor the most.

rows.name: Reverse-Feint
rows.description: You can goad an opponent into attacking you in order to make your counter attack all the more powerful.

rows.name: Risky Striker
rows.description: You can make yourself a little more vulnerable to larger creatures in order to land a devastating blow.

rows.name: Scorching Weapons
rows.description: Elemental fire stirs within your body, boiling your blood and rendering you resistant to flame.

rows.name: Sea Hunter
rows.description: Your blows knock swimming opponents off balance.

rows.name: Sharpclaw
rows.description: Your nails are large and strong.

rows.name: Shatterspell
rows.description: Your mighty blows shatter your enemy's magic.

rows.name: Spit Venom
rows.description: You have mastered the nagaji warrior technique of spitting venom into your opponent's eyes.

rows.name: Surprise Follow-Through
rows.description: When striking one opponent, you catch its ally off guard.

rows.name: Surprise Strike
rows.description: You actually seem to do more damage when frantically trying to avoid your enemies.

rows.name: Sympathetic Rage
rows.description: Seeing an ally rage fills you with your own fury.

rows.name: Tail Terror
rows.description: You have strengthened your tail enough to make slap attacks with it.

rows.name: Tangle Feet
rows.description: Creatures who cross your path find themselves tripping over their own feet.

rows.name: Taskmaster
rows.description: You intimidate weaker allies into reckless ferocity.

rows.name: Tree Hanger
rows.description: You can use your tail to defend against trip attacks and to hang from nearby protrusions.

rows.name: Uncanny Defense
rows.description: Your instinct for self-preservation gives you many advantages.

rows.name: Vast Hatred
rows.description: Your rage stretches beyond normal bounds.
